The moon of Selector houses an armory deep within its snowy peaks. Once used for storing various weaponry to aid in times of war now lies abandoned waiting to be opened once more.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Abandoned.

CONDITIONS: Cold, lush terrain, oxygen rich atmosphere.

FAUNA: FAUNA: A stable ecosystem, dominated by insects.

> Environment

Selector is a hilly, snowy, and forested moon with mountainous terrain. Plant life is rather abundant in the form of tall grass, bushes, and trees. Several large and small rocks can be found on the exterior as well.

Its most prominent landmark the is the colossal concrete and metal building behind the ship. Two elevators to the left and right behind the ship can be interacted with to descend into a deep chasm with several stalactites and stalagmites. The main entrance and both fire exits can be found at the bottom leading into the building. A Log translator and Floppy disc machine can be found at the bottom as well.

Forest Ambience

Cave Ambience

> Weather

Selector supports Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Cache

A Cache of scrap can be found northeast of the ship in a small patch of open terrain. This Cache will always spawn a Recovery order and will additionally spawn up to six random items from a pool of Cables, Circuit boards, Copper wiring, Lithium, Steel ingots, and at a much lower chance Triangulation devices. The Cache will reroll its generated items with each landing, so players can leave and return to Selector if they dislike the items on it. However, as soon as any player gets too close to the Cache it will only spawn the Recovery order on future landings on that save file.

Major Story Spoilers: Falling Debris

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall to the left (north) of the ship on the exterior of Selector. If players land on Selector in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and two Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Crafting a Blank floppy disc on Galetry, inserting it into the Floppy disc machine found on the exterior of Fission-C, and logging the Selector floppy disc.

Unlocks

Dormant: Craft a Blank floppy disc on Galetry, insert it into the Floppy disc machine found on the exterior, and log the Dormant floppy disc.
ResearcherxB: This moon can be one of the random moons that requires placing a Triangulation device on its exterior.
Vindict: Log Recovery order found on the Cache northeast of the ship.

> Trivia

  • Selector has the highest and lowest chance of generating a specific interior by default in Wesley's Moons, boasting a 999,999,999 in 1,000,000,355 chance to generate the Grand Armory and a 1 in 1,000,000,355 chance to generate the Carnival, Mansion, or Mineshaft interior.
